note: What a server sends to move units along paths of its own choosing, stating how each one travels rather than leaving it to the receiving end. It is what carries a unit thrown, dragged, or carried along by something other than its own walking. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Names this statement of movement.

fields.name: movementCount
fields.note: How many units follow. A client reads it as signed, so a count above 32767 counts as none, as zero does.

fields.name: movements
fields.note: What each unit is told to do.

revisions.note: A client answers each with WaypointAck, naming this sync id and listing, in order, each unit whose path carried a teleport token with that token.
